description_en: Queries the auto scaling history of an instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeAutoScalingHistory接口，查询实例弹性伸缩历史信息
kebab_example: aliyun das describe-auto-scaling-history --instance-id rm-2ze8g2am976240000 --auto-scaling-task-type SPEC --start-time 1675833788056 --end-time 1676605305796 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeAutoScalingHistory

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

Only ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instances are supported
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

当前仅支持RDS MySQL实例
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the auto scaling task that you want to query. Set the value to SPEC, which indicates that you can query the history of only automatic performance scaling tasks
parameters.help_zh: 查询的弹性伸缩业务种类。当前仅支持SPEC，表示仅支持查询自动性能扩展历史信息
parameters.name: auto_scaling_task_type

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

The maximum time range that can be specified is 45 days
parameters.help_zh:
查询任务的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。

查询任务的开始时间最大不能早于当前时间45天
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
查询任务结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒。
查询任务结束时间需晚于查询任务开始时间
parameters.name: end_time

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code returned. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful

Bandwidth.description_en: The history of automatic bandwidth scaling of ApsaraDB for Redis instances. This feature is not supported
Bandwidth.description_zh: Redis带宽弹性伸缩历史记录，暂不支持

items.description_en: The history of automatic bandwidth scaling of the ApsaraDB for Redis instance
items.description_zh: Redis带宽弹性伸缩历史信息

Resource.description_en: The history of resource scale-out of ApsaraDB for Redis instances. This feature is not supported
Resource.description_zh: Redis资源扩容历史记录，暂不支持

items.description_en: The history of resource scale-out of the ApsaraDB for Redis instance

Shard.description_en: The history of automatic shard scale-out of ApsaraDB for Redis instances. This feature is not supported
Shard.description_zh: Redis自动分片扩容历史记录，暂不支持

items.description_en: The history of automatic shard scale-out of the ApsaraDB for Redis instance
items.description_zh: Redis自动分片扩容历史信息

SpecHistory.description_en: The history of automatic performance scaling
SpecHistory.description_zh: 自动性能扩展历史记录

items.description_zh: 自动性能扩展历史信息

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code returned by the scaling task. Valid values:

Insufficient_Balance: The account has insufficient balance or an unpaid order.

REACH_SPEC_UPPERBOUND: The instance type reaches the upper limit.

Control_Error_Timeout_Msg: The management task timed out.

Invoke_Rds_Api_Error_Msg: Failed to call the ApsaraDB RDS API
ErrorCode.description_zh:
扩缩容内部任务返回的错误码：

Insufficient_Balance ：用户余额不足或存在未支付订单。
REACH_SPEC_UPPERBOUND ：已达到用户规格上限。
Control_Error_Timeout_Msg ：管控任务超时。
Invoke_Rds_Api_Error_Msg ：调用RDS API失败

OriginCore.description_en: The original number of CPU cores of the instance

OriginMemory.description_en: The original memory size of the instance. Unit: GB
OriginMemory.description_zh: 原始实例内存大小，单位GB

ScaleType.description_en:
The type of the automatic performance scaling task. Valid values:

SCALE_UP: automatic instance type scale-up task.

SCALE_DOWN: automatic instance type scale-down task
ScaleType.description_zh:
自动性能扩展任务类型，取值：
SCALE_UP：规格自动扩容。
SCALE_DOWN：规格自动缩容

TargetCore.description_en: The destination number of CPU cores of the instance

TargetMemory.description_en: The destination memory size of the instance. Unit: GB
TargetMemory.description_zh: 目标实例内存大小，单位GB

TaskExcuteStatus.description_en:
The status of the task. Valid values:

true: The task was successful.

false: The task failed
TaskExcuteStatus.description_zh:
任务执行状态：
true：执行成功。
false：执行失败

TaskTime.description_en: The time when the task was run. Set this parameter to a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
TaskTime.description_zh: 任务执行时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位为毫秒

Storage.description_en: The history of storage expansion. This feature is not supported
Storage.description_zh: 存储扩容历史记录，暂不支持

items.description_en: The history of storage expansion of the instance
items.description_zh: 实例存储扩容历史信息

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Successful is returned. Otherwise, an error message such as an error code is returned
Message.description_zh:
请求返回消息。
请求成功时该参数返回Successful，请求失败时会返回请求异常信息（如错误码等）

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
请求是否执行成功：

true：执行成功。
false：执行失败
